poster, banner and shop sign textures (AI-generated, supplied by the team)
what_i_found: There is not one audio file in this build: every sound, including the music, is synthesised at runtime by the Web Audio API, and the music is a scheduler rather than a loop so it has no seam to hear. That is why the whole game is about 1 MB. The bugs that actually mattered were found by gates that drive the game with real key, pointer and touch events rather than debug hooks: swinging with your back to an enemy at 1.5 m, an objective held open by enemies 350 m away, and an exit walled off by its own scenery.
